items.headline: Rip Current Statement issued October 25 at 7:43AM EDT until October 28 at 2:00AM EDT by NWS Miami FL
items.description:
* WHAT...Moderate coastal flooding around periods of high tide,
reaching major flood stage on Monday and Tuesday. Life
threatening rip currents are expected.

* WHERE...Coastal Broward County and Coastal Miami Dade County.

* WHEN...For the Coastal Flood Advisory, until 2 AM EDT Monday.
For the Coastal Flood Warning, from 2 AM Monday to 8 PM EDT
Tuesday. Coastal Flood Advisories will then be necessary through
much of next week after the peak of King Tides. For the High
Rip Current Risk, through late Tuesday night.

* IMPACTS...Numerous roads may be closed. Low lying property
including homes, businesses, and some critical infrastructure
will be inundated. Some shoreline erosion will occur. Rip
currents can sweep even the best swimmers away from shore into
deeper water.
items.instruction:
Take the necessary actions to protect flood-prone property. If
travel is required, do not drive around barricades or through
water of unknown depth.

Swim near a lifeguard. If caught in a rip current, relax and
float. Don't swim against the current. If able, swim in a
direction following the shoreline. If unable to escape, face the
shore and call or wave for help.

items.headline: Small Craft Advisory issued October 25 at 7:57AM EDT until October 25 at 8:00PM EDT by NWS Miami FL
items.description:
* WHAT...Northeast winds 20 to 25 knots with gusts near 30 knots
and seas 8 to 12 feet through today. Starting tonight, frequent
gusts to Gale force are expected and are forecast to continue
through most of Tuesday. Seas will continue to build and are
expected to peak around 12 to 15 feet on Monday. Gale conditions
should subside to Advisory levels once again by Tuesday night.

* WHERE...Coastal waters from Jupiter Inlet to Deerfield Beach
FL out 20 NM, Coastal waters from Deerfield Beach to Ocean
Reef FL out 20 NM, Waters from Jupiter Inlet to Deerfield
Beach FL from 20 to 60 NM and Waters from Deerfield Beach to
Ocean Reef FL from 20 to 60 NM excluding the territorial
waters of Bahamas.

* WHEN...Small Craft Advisory, until 8 PM EDT this evening, then a
Gale Warning, from 8 PM this evening to 8 PM EDT Tuesday. A
Small Craft Advisory will then replace the Gale Warning from
midweek onward.

* IMPACTS...Strong winds will cause hazardous seas which could
capsize or damage vessels and reduce visibility.
items.instruction:
Mariners should alter plans to avoid these hazardous conditions.
Remain in port, seek safe harbor, alter course, and/or secure the
vessel for hazardous conditions.
